name: Trendy Women’s Shoulder Bag – Compact & Stylish Everyday Bag RM120
description:
Type: Shoulder Bag, Handheld
Material: Cloth
Size: Width 28.5 cm × Height 22 cm × Thickness 10 cm
Handle/Strap Height: 29 cm
Weight: 0.29 kg
Carry Type: Shoulder

Compact & Functional: Perfect for carrying daily essentials like mobile phones, wallets, and cosmetics.

Trendy Design: Colorful patterns make it stylish and suitable for casual outings.

Lightweight & Comfortable: Easy to carry with shoulder strap or by hand.

Versatile Use: Ideal for everyday use, shopping, commuting, or casual events.
